concepts.title: ① 轻侧身 · 专注
concepts.prompt:
Edit the supplied Xiaoduo mascot image into ONE square CheckLine app-icon concept. User likes this exact idea: a purple cloud mascot with a lavender liquid level inside its own body, two warm ivory oval eyes, no mouth. Keep the cloud identity, organic asymmetric lobes, rich amethyst upper body, lavender lower fill, and internal liquid boundary. The user wants a more characterful angle and pose, not an extra object. Do not add cards, wallets, trays, props, hats, money signs, text, hands, arms, feet, eyelids with lashes, eyebrows or extra characters. White-pearl full-bleed opaque SQUARE background, no rounded outer icon mask or frame; single bold form, readable thumbnail eyes. Soft translucent satin material, quiet controlled studio light, reduce the strong glossy hotspots in the source. Maintain a clear high-contrast cloud silhouette. The liquid boundary is physically inside the cloud, below both eyes, roughly level with gravity with one gentle restrained slosh. Pose the three-dimensional cloud volume and its eyes coherently; DO NOT just rotate the existing flat picture. Output just the individual icon artwork, no labels, contact sheet or device mockup.
POSE A — QUIET THREE-QUARTER TURN. The cloud's actual volume is turned about 25 degrees toward the viewer's left, with the face still looking back toward the viewer. Show a subtle narrower far side, small near-side cheek prominence, perspective variation in the lobes, and slightly different eye widths. Both familiar ivory vertical oval eyes are entirely visible and clearly separated, grouped just off center on the front-facing curved surface. A small upward lift of the nearer upper lobe gives an attentive, curious but calm expression without a mouth. Keep the whole cloud contained in the canvas at 82 percent width with balanced breathing room. Slightly asymmetric stance with its weight to one lower lobe; no dramatic tilt. The liquid level stays roughly horizontal in world space, its visible boundary wrapping around the turned body. Confident companion personality, clean mature app branding, not rigid front-on symmetry.
